_comment: Canonical interface between Viable Systems in ~/vsf. Every recursive VSM level exposes exactly this contract.
_spec: @vsm 0.2 — system_id is the stable identifier; level is frame-local

_changelog.0.2.1: Added formal invariant fields per Qwen ronda 4: variety_delta (VAR-1), trust_score (TRUST-1), algedonic_seq (ALG-1) + algedonic_channel section + new event_types

upward_channel.description: Append-only event stream. Child reports what happened. Parent uses this to assess variety and intervene.

event_schema.system_id: stable identifier of the emitting system (not L-indexed)
event_schema.event_type: tool_run | phase_complete | thermal_wait | token_usage | anomaly | param_change | signal_escalated | signal_deferred | invariant_check | algedonic_emit | drift_alert
event_schema.duration_s: float — wall time of the operation
event_schema.metrics: object — event-type specific payload (see event_types below)
event_schema.variety_delta: float — Ashby variety absorbed minus emitted by this regulator step (VAR-1 invariant). May be null for non-regulator events.
event_schema.trust_score: float ∈ [0,1] — current trust of emitting system (TRUST-1 composition input)
event_schema.algedonic_seq: int — monotonic counter of algedonic emissions from this system_id since boot (ALG-1 cascade detection). 0 if event is not algedonic.
event_schema.prev_hash: string (sha256 hex) — hash of previous event in this jsonl, for Merkle chain integrity. Null on first event.
event_schema.hash: string (sha256 hex) — hash of this event (excluding the hash field itself). Required for chain validation by S3*.

signal_deferred.deferred_count: int — total deferred in this level

invariant_check.invariant_id: string — e.g. VAR-1, TRUST-1, ALG-1, S1_I1...

algedonic_emit.reason: string — what triggered the algedonic signal
algedonic_emit.gate_passed: bool — whether algedonic_gate (hysteresis + decay) allowed emission
algedonic_emit._note: Payload semantics are BINARY (gate_passed=true implies signal fired). Urgency is NOT a payload field — expressed via routing priority (NATS Core subject) per VSL prescription.

drift_alert.delta_sigmas: float — how many stddev from baseline (drift magnitude)

algedonic_channel._comment: Cross-cutting urgency channel — bypasses normal hierarchy. BINARY semantic per VSL.
algedonic_channel.carrier_canonical: NATS Core (no JetStream — sub-ms latency, no fsync)
algedonic_channel.semantics: BINARY — φ_algedonic ∈ {0, 1}. NO urgency levels in payload. Urgency expressed via routing priority at carrier layer.

gate.purpose: Prevent cascade saturation of S5 in recursive V trees
gate.hysteresis: tunable per emitter, baseline from invariant_checker

payload_schema.algedonic_seq: int — monotonic counter (for ALG-1 cascade detection)

downward_channel.description: Parameter file. Parent writes tuning values. Child reads at startup of each tick(L). Decoupled — child works with defaults if file absent.

example_tool_conductor._reason: L2 analysis: gau causes temp spike > 70°C in 80% of runs

lateral_channel._comment: ψ channel — inter-VSM coupling via S4 (D11). Not a sibling channel — A4 still applies within a tree.
lateral_channel.participants: V_A.id, V_B.id — must not be siblings

connection_graph._comment: Semantic map of system relationships. system_id is stable; level is frame-local.
connection_graph._note_on_psi: ψ edges are not listed here — they are established dynamically via credential-manager after handshake (D11)
